source.label: Reddit, Inc. Form 10-K for fiscal year 2025, Item 1, Human Capital
source.quote: As of December 31, 2025, we had 2,555 employees, including 1,981 in the United States.

source.label: Reddit, Inc. Form 10-K for fiscal year 2025, Item 2, Properties
source.quote: Our corporate headquarters is located in San Francisco, California, where we lease approximately 48,000 square feet of office space pursuant to a lease agreement that expires in 2029

notes: FY2025 10-K only. The 10-K gives the U.S. headcount (1,981 of 2,555 at Dec 31, 2025); the non-U.S. remainder was not derived. Item 2 also mentions leased offices in New York, Chicago, Los Angeles and London without detail, so they are not listed as sites. No state or tax-by-country data is published.
